name: axHub connection
author: Brett
description: Checks the Dev Console's axHub connection (its hub token against the hub's MCP endpoint) and returns the hub. Patches reads it on every page load and paints its attachable badge `hub-connection` at the top left of its banner, next to the Claude badge: the hub icon + the signed-in hub account when it connects, or “No axHub connection · check keys” when it doesn't. Icons and colours per state are picked in its settings (two icons, or one icon in two colours). Never returns the token.
